Transaction fuzz harness, serialization, execution, and result capture for runtime tests.

# Purpose
This file implements the Solana runtime fuzz execution path for a single test case. It builds a transaction execution environment from fuzz input, restores bank state, sysvars, feature flags, blockhash data, and account data, then parses and executes the transaction against the runtime. The main entry point, [`fd_solfuzz_txn_run`](<#fd_solfuzz_txn_run>), also collects the execution result into a test result structure, including sanitization status, instruction errors, fees, return data, compute unit use, and resulting account state.

The file also contains the transaction serializer [`fd_runtime_fuzz_serialize_txn`](<#fd_runtime_fuzz_serialize_txn>), which converts a sanitized transaction description into raw transaction bytes in Solana wire format. Helper code creates and tears down transaction context state, attaches Funk and progcache transactions, and cancels changes after execution with [`fd_runtime_fuzz_xid_cancel`](<#fd_runtime_fuzz_xid_cancel>). Together, these functions provide the core harness logic used to run fuzzed transactions through the runtime and record the outcome.
